triage.kind_span: This Amendment No. 2 is the final amendment to the Schedule TO and is being filed (i) to report the final results of the Exchange Offer

subject_names.span: The Gabelli Dividend & Income Trust, a Delaware statutory trust

subject_tickers.span: The Board of Trustees of The Gabelli Dividend & Income Trust (NYSE:GDV)

security_class.span: relating to the Issuers offer to exchange up to 100% of the Issuers preferred shares, designated Series B Auction Market Preferred Shares, Series C Auction Market Preferred Shares and Series E Auction Rate Preferred Shares

price_basis.span: existing holders of the Auction Rate Preferred Shares were entitled to receive 0.96 of each newly issued Series J Preferred Share for each Auction Rate Preferred Share validly tendered and not withdrawn pursuant to the Offer

size_pct_outstanding.span: offer to exchange up to 100% of the Issuers preferred shares

size_shares.span: Calculated as the aggregate maximum purchase price to be paid for 6,371 shares in the exchange offer

commencement_date.span: Under the terms of the Offer, which commenced March 17, 2021 and expired April 14, 2021

expiration_date.span: The Exchange Offer expired at 5:00 p.m. New York City time, on April 14, 2021.

shares_tendered.span: 6,105 Auction Rate Preferred Shares were validly tendered and not withdrawn prior to the expiration of the Exchange Offer

shares_accepted.span: all 6,105 Auction Rate Preferred Shares, representing 95.8% of the outstanding Auction Rate Preferred Shares on the Expiration Date, were accepted for exchange

notes: Issuer exchange offer (Schedule TO-I, final Amendment No. 2) by GDV for its Series B, C and E auction rate preferred shares, in exchange for Series J Cumulative Term Preferred Shares (0.96 Series J share, liquidation preference $25,000, per auction rate preferred share) plus cash in lieu of fractional shares. Classified cef_tender as an issuer tender/exchange offer for its own preferred shares. Conflict: the Schedule TO body (doc 1) reports 6,105 shares validly tendered and all 6,105 accepted (95.8% of outstanding); the press release (doc 2) says 6,106 shares tendered (96% of outstanding) in exchange for 5,817 Series J shares plus $1,119,000 cash. Used the doc 1 figures. Consideration is in kind, not cash: the fee note values it at 96% of the $25,000 liquidation preference ($24,000 per share), but this is a fee-calculation basis, so final_price_per_share is left null. price_pct_nav null: the price is set against liquidation preference, not NAV. size_shares 6,371 is the share count used for the maximum fee valuation. No proration factor is stated (all tendered shares accepted; a 100% factor would be inferred). Conditions and the reason for the offer are not stated in this excerpt. Ticker GDV is the fund's common-share ticker; the preferreds are identified by CUSIP only.
